chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil, may God have mercy on him, said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Ashari, from Salama ibn al-Khattab, from al-Husayn ibn Said al-Azdi, from Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Abdullah ibn Sabbah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, who said:

When the Day of Resurrection comes, God will gather the former and the latter peoples on a single plain, and an intense darkness will cover them. They will cry out to their Lord saying: O Lord, remove this darkness from us!

He said: Then a people will come forward with light walking before them, having illuminated the ground of the Resurrection. The people of the gathering will say: These are the prophets of God! Then the call will come from God: These are not prophets. The people of the gathering will say: Then these are angels! The call will come from God: These are not angels. The people of the gathering will say: These are martyrs! The call will come from God: These are not martyrs.

They will say: Who are they? The call will come: O people of the gathering, ask them who they are! The people of the gathering will say: Who are you? They will say: We are the Alids. We are the progeny of Muhammad, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family. We are the children of Ali, the friend of God. We are the ones singled out by the honor of God. We are the safe and assured ones.

Then the call will come to them from God, the Mighty and Majestic: Intercede for your lovers, the people of your affection, and your Shia! So they will intercede, and their intercession will be accepted.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the descendants of Ali on the Day of Resurrection according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this teaching addressed to Abu Basir, Imam al-Sadiq describes a dramatic eschatological scene at the Resurrection. When intense darkness covers all of humanity on a single plain, a luminous group emerges whose light illuminates the entire ground. The assembled people guess they are prophets, then angels, then martyrs, but God denies each guess. When finally asked, the luminous group identifies themselves as the Alids -- descendants of Prophet Muhammad and children of Ali, singled out by divine honor. God then commands them to intercede for those who loved them, and their intercession is accepted. This hadith reflects the Shi'a doctrine of the exalted eschatological station of the Prophet's family and their power of intercession (shafa'a) on the Day of Judgment.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar narrated to us from Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Ash`ari from Salama b. al-Khattab from al-Husayn b. Sa`id al-Azdi from Ishaq b. Ibrahim from `Abdullah b. Sabah from Abi Basir from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as). He said:

On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will gather the former and latter peoples on one plane, and He will cover them in intense darkness. So, they will go to their Lord and say: “O Lord! Alleviate us of this darkness.” He said:

So, a people will come with light before them, which will light up the world of the Resurrection. So, the gathered people will say: “Are these the prophets of Allah?” A call from Allah will come and say: “These are not My prophets.” So, the gathered people will say: “Are these angels?” So, a call from Allah will come and say: “These are not angels.” So, the gathered people will say: “Are these martyrs?” So, a call from Allah will come and say: “These are not martyrs.”

So, they will say: “Who are they?” So, a call will come and say: “O gathered people! Ask them who they are.” So, the gathered people will say: “Who are you?” So, they will say: “We are the `Alids. We are the progeny of Muhammad the Messenger of Allah (s). We are the children of `Ali the Friend of Allah. We are the ones dignified by the blessing of Allah. We are the safe and pleased ones.”
So, a call from Allah will come and say: “Intercede for your lovers and your Shi`a”, so they will be interceded, and they will intercede.
